invariants: INV-GOV-CAP-ACYCLIC-DAG: Capability dependency graph must remain strictly acyclic (DAG).
INV-GOV-CAP-ACTIVE-REQUIRES-PROOF: Neither root registry nor individual capabilities may be declared ACTIVE without verified milestone activation proof.

provisions.statement: All registered capabilities must declare valid layer, owner domain, lifecycle status, and provenance.
ACTIVE lifecycle status requires independently verified milestone activation proof record matching Git commit and tree objects.

scope: Machine-readable capability registry, architectural layering, strict DAG acyclicity, and fail-closed activation gate.
title: Synthesis Capability Registry and Lifecycle Contract
